analyst: The script is a strategy that opens positions from a pivot-confirmation entry, not from a moving-average trigger. A trade opens when the pivot confirmation lines up with the POC delta imbalance filter, price is on the required side of the VWMA, confirmation volume is high, and the Smart Trail agrees with the intended direction. The stop is a dollar stop from the Stop ($) input, used to place long_stop below close and short_stop above close by Stop ($) divided by point value. It also closes the position when open profit reaches the negative Stop ($) level, while a take-profit target and optional trailing stop are available.
